---
title: "2026 US Senate Elections"
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(tigris)
library(leaflet)

options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

# Download and simplify NC precinct (voting district) boundaries
nc_vtd <- voting_districts(state = "NC", year = 2020) |>
  st_transform(4326) |>
  st_simplify(dTolerance = 0.001)

# Add county names using FIPS codes
data(fips_codes, package = "tigris")
nc_fips <- fips_codes |>
  filter(state == "NC") |>
  mutate(County = toupper(str_remove(county, " County")))

vtd_clean <- nc_vtd |>
  left_join(nc_fips, by = c("COUNTYFP20" = "county_code")) |>
  mutate(
    key_vtd = toupper(str_remove(str_replace_all(VTDST20, "[^A-Za-z0-9]", ""), "^0+")),
    key_name = toupper(str_remove(str_replace_all(NAME20, "[^A-Za-z0-9]", ""), "^0+"))
  )

# Calculate the winning candidate in each precinct
senate_results <- read_tsv("data/north-carolina/results_pct_20261103.txt", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(`Contest Name` == "US SENATE", `Real Precinct` == "Y") |>
  group_by(County, Precinct, Choice, `Choice Party`) |>
  summarize(votes = sum(`Total Votes`), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(County, Precinct) |>
  slice_max(votes, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(key = toupper(str_remove(str_replace_all(Precinct, "[^A-Za-z0-9]", ""), "^0+")))

# Join results to spatial polygons by precinct ID, filling unmatched with precinct name
joined_vtd <- vtd_clean |>
  left_join(senate_results, by = c("County", "key_vtd" = "key"))

unmatched_idx <- which(is.na(joined_vtd$Choice))
fill_data <- vtd_clean[unmatched_idx, ] |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(COUNTYFP20, VTDST20, County, key_name) |>
  left_join(senate_results, by = c("County", "key_name" = "key"))

joined_vtd$Choice[unmatched_idx] <- fill_data$Choice
joined_vtd$votes[unmatched_idx] <- fill_data$votes
joined_vtd$Precinct[unmatched_idx] <- fill_data$Precinct

# Color palette matching the candidates
pal <- colorFactor(
  palette = c("Roy Cooper" = "#2b83ba", "Michael Whatley" = "#d7191c", "Michael Dublin" = "#fdae61"),
  domain = joined_vtd$Choice,
  na.color = "#d9d9d9"
)

# Interactive leaflet map
leaflet(joined_vtd) |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) |>
  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~pal(Choice),
    weight = 0.5,
    color = "white",
    fillOpacity = 0.7,
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(weight = 2, color = "#444", fillOpacity = 0.9, bringToFront = TRUE),
    label = ~paste0(County, " - Precinct ", coalesce(Precinct, NAME20), ": ", coalesce(Choice, "No data"), " (", coalesce(as.character(votes), "N/A"), " votes)")
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    pal = pal,
    values = ~Choice,
    title = "Winning Candidate",
    position = "bottomright"
  )
```
